desk_read: The dominant theme this week is broad risk reduction and short building across asset classes alongside falling futures prices. Leveraged funds in US 10Y T-Note pushed net short by another -181.1k contracts as their net position moved toward short for 4 consecutive weeks, creating a crowded short with a COT index 4. Natural Gas also shows a crowded short with a COT index 4, though its net position moved toward long for 2 consecutive weeks despite a -2.7% drop in the futures price. Meanwhile, S&P 500 displays an extended long with a COT index 86, highlighting a notable divergence where the futures price dropped -2.5% while funds added net length as the net position moved toward long for 3 consecutive weeks, leaving this large position fragile.
